purpose: refit the frozen monthly SPARROW+legacy+H1+C-Q architecture with the accepted DYN2P+SIG2P water interface and evaluate old and recent temporal transfer
fixed_architecture: DYN2P+SIG2P water -> F00 -> S0/S1-12 x mu={12,36,60,96,144,240} -> fixed effective TN lag -> H1_GLOBAL -> Gaussian C-Q hinge -> P1/P2 MAP readout

parameter_training.method: penalized Gaussian MAP equivalent to the frozen ridge/prior objective
parameter_training.forbidden_borrowing: no parameter may be reused across hydrology versions, folds, layers or ensemble members

evaluation.historical_backcast: 2016-2020 using final 2021-2024 MAP; descriptive, not validation

observation_domain: strict matched primary-river station-month TN; open-water tree 163 diagnostic only

layers.P1: globally scaled fast/slow pathway layer without station identity
layers.P2: monitored-station prediction layer with ridge station intercept

reference: 20260824_4 old-Q72 Gaussian C-Q hinge on the exact 2018-2021 OOF keys

decision_boundary.water_interface: adopted on hydrologic and conservation evidence, independent of TN score
decision_boundary.TN_prediction_upgrade: must be reported separately for P1 and P2; P2 cannot establish spatial transfer
decision_boundary.spatial_claim: not tested here and remains unsupported
decision_boundary.recent_folds: correlated rolling-origin tests, not three independent experiments
